title: Best Ps5 Pro (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were based on mentions in TechRadar, PCWorld, IGN and CNET articles about the PS5 Pro.
assumptions: No price comparisons were made because only the $700 price appears in CNET and PCWorld; no other consoles were listed in the sources.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want the most powerful PlayStation console with better ray tracing and smoother frame rates; it’s ideal for enthusiasts who want 4K/8K visuals. The main catch is its high price and lack of a built‑in disc drive.
